rows.vgi.author: Query Farm <hello@query.farm>
rows.vgi.doc_llm: XGBoost for SQL. Load datasets; fit gradient-boosted models (fit returns a model `BLOB`, predict aligns features by name and decodes string labels); run typed fit_<estimator>, grid and randomized hyperparameter search, feature importance, SHAP explanations, partial dependence, and permutation importance — all as DuckDB table functions.
rows.vgi.doc_md:
# XGBoost for SQL

Exposes [XGBoost](https://xgboost.ai) to DuckDB/SQL as VGI functions:

- **Datasets** — toy datasets and generators
- **Models** — `fit`/`predict`, typed `fit_<estimator>`, cross-validation, grid/randomized search
- **Interpretation** — feature importance, SHAP `explain`, partial dependence, permutation importance

Models are stored as reusable BLOBs in a registry; native UBJSON serialization.
rows.vgi.executable_examples: [{"description": "Load the built-in iris dataset.", "sql": "SELECT * FROM xgboost.main.iris LIMIT 5"}, {"description": "Fit an XGBoost classifier on iris, then predict with the fitted model.", "sql": ["SET VARIABLE iris_model = (SELECT model FROM xgboost.main.fit((SELECT * FROM xgboost.main.iris), estimator := 'xgb_classifier', target := 'target', id := 'sample_id'))", "SELECT sample_id, prediction FROM xgboost.main.predict((SELECT * FROM xgboost.main.iris), model := getvariable('iris_model'), id := 'sample_id') LIMIT 5"]}, {"description": "Three-fold cross-validated accuracy of an XGBoost classifier on iris.", "sql": "SELECT fold, score FROM xgboost.main.cross_val_score((SELECT * EXCLUDE (target_name) FROM xgboost.main.iris), estimator := 'xgb_classifier', target := 'target', cv := 3)"}, {"description": "Grid-search an XGBoost classifier on iris over a tiny grid (3-fold).", "sql": "SELECT params, mean_test_score, rank FROM xgboost.main.grid_search((SELECT * EXCLUDE (target_name) FROM xgboost.main.iris), target := 'target', cv := 3, estimator := union_value(xgb_classifier := {'n_estimators': [25, 50], 'max_depth': [3]})) ORDER BY rank"}, {"description": "Out-of-fold confusion matrix for an XGBoost iris classifier: 5-fold cross_val_predict on the species name, joined back to the iris table by sample_id and counted per (actual, predicted) species pair. Only non-empty cells are returned; the off-diagonal rows are the held-out misclassifications, almost all of them versicolor/virginica mix-ups.", "sql": "SELECT i.target_name AS actual_species, cv.prediction AS predicted_species, count(*) AS n_flowers FROM xgboost.main.cross_val_predict((SELECT sample_id, sepal_length_cm, sepal_width_cm, petal_length_cm, petal_width_cm, target_name FROM xgboost.main.iris), estimator := 'xgb_classifier', target := 'target_name', id := 'sample_id', cv := 5) AS cv JOIN xgboost.main.iris AS i USING (sample_id) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY actual_species, predicted_species"}]
